## Snapshot columns and candidate derivations

`now` = snapshot label 1820 read as ET wall-clock on the ET date of the latest event (2026-03-17) = `2026-03-17T18:20:00.000-04:00` (epoch ms 1773786000000). Brief: "The reference point for 'now' is 18:20:00 ET." Checks below use events with event_time <= now, de-duplicated with the OQ-04 default key (event_id + payload), ordered by event_time.

### `snapshot_open_consults_1820.csv`

| column | proposed derivation | rows matching | mismatches |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `consult_id` | Consults with at least one event and no `note_signed` (open = not Signed Off). | 18/18 |  |
| `hospital_id` | `hospital_id` of the consult_received event. | 18/18 |  |
| `hospital_name` | Join hospital_id to hospitals.csv. | 18/18 |  |
| `physician_id` | `physician_id` of the latest physician_assigned; "Unassigned" if none (incoming_call_ringing does not assign). | 18/18 |  |
| `consult_type` | consult_received description "<type> consult request received" (only source of the type; OQ-14). | 18/18 |  |
| `current_stage` | Stage of the latest stage-changing event: consult_received→Received, consult_triaged→Triaged, physician_assigned→Assigned, incoming_call_started (while Assigned)→Provider Contacted, imaging_requested→CT/CTA or Imaging Pending, imaging_returned→Imaging Review, video_started→Video Consult In Progress, video_ended→Note Pending, note_started→Documentation, note_signed→Signed Off. Outgoing calls, call ends, ringing and routing failures do not change stage (OQ-18). | 18/18 |  |
| `stage_entered_at` | ET clock time (HH:MM:SS) of that stage-changing event. | 18/18 |  |
| `minutes_in_stage` | floor((now - stage_entered_at) / 60 000), using the file's own stage_entered_at as ET on the scenario date. | 18/18 |  |
| `minutes_since_received` | floor((now - consult_received.event_time) / 60 000). | 18/18 |  |

Stage → entering event type observed in the snapshot: Video Consult In Progress ← video_started (2); CT/CTA or Imaging Pending ← imaging_requested (1); Note Pending ← video_ended (6); Provider Contacted ← incoming_call_started (1); Triaged ← consult_triaged (2); Imaging Review ← imaging_returned (2); Documentation ← note_started (2); Received ← consult_received (1); Assigned ← physician_assigned (1).

## Coverage requirements and baseline volume: time semantics

**coverage_requirements.csv**: the header names the block column `time_block_et`, so blocks are ET wall-clock. Distinct blocks: `07:00-16:00`, `16:00-22:00`, `22:00-07:00`; each hospital has 3 blocks that tile 24 h (the loader warns otherwise). A block whose end is before its start wraps midnight. Requirement values: 2 (6 rows), 1 (30 rows). Boundary ownership (is 16:00 in the first or second block?) and the meaning of "available" are not stated: OQ-01, OQ-02.

Hospitals with a requirement of 2+ in any block: SYN-001, SYN-003, SYN-008; coverage_tier "A" hospitals: SYN-001, SYN-003, SYN-008. They coincide (tier A = higher daytime requirement).

**baseline_hourly_volume.csv**: the header names the hour column `hour_start_et`, so hours are ET. dow_type values: `weekday`; weeks_sampled: 12; mean_consults range 0.05–1.26; p90_consults range 0–3 (p90 values are whole numbers). Each row is read as consults received in [hour_start, hour_start + 1 h) ET.

## Off-shift roster: fields vs eligibility rules

| needed for | column | present |
| --- | --- | --- |
| opt-in ("They have opted in to split-shift offers") | `split_shift_opt_in` | yes |
| last shift end ("At least 10 hours have passed since their last shift ended") | `last_shift_end` | yes |
| next shift start ("does not overlap a shift they are already scheduled for") | `next_shift_start` | yes |
| hours in trailing 7 days ("Hours worked in the trailing 7 days plus the offered hours do not exceed 60") | `hours_worked_last_7d` | yes |
| minutes to come online ("The estimated time to come online counts against the value of the offer") | `est_minutes_to_online` | yes |
| channel (offer delivery) | `preferred_channel` | yes |
| declines (ranking signal; not an eligibility rule) | `offers_declined_last_30d` | yes |
| role (Day / Night / Float) | `role` | yes |

Missing for the rules in the brief: (1) offers already sent this week ("no more than 3 offers per physician per week"): no column, and `offers_declined_last_30d` is a 30-day decline count, not a weekly offer count (OQ-09); (2) open offers per physician: no column (our offer log is the source); (3) next shift end: not needed if an offer must end by next_shift_start (OQ-21); (4) physicians_on_shift.csv has no role column, so day/night for the routing low-volume threshold must be inferred (OQ-10). Roster roles present: `Day`, `Float`, `Night`; opt-in: 4 Yes / 2 No.

physicians_on_shift.csv `split_shift_opt_in` values: `n/a (on shift)` (not a Yes/No; kept verbatim).
